title: Schemes are sober
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Every irreducible closed subset $Z$ of the underlying topological space of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has exactly one generic point [def-sc-generic-point]: there is a unique $\xi\in Z$ with $Z=\overline{\{\xi\}}$. In particular every irreducible component of $X$ (a closed irreducible subset) has a unique generic point.
